data_fields.name: map_panel_rows
data_fields.donor_constant: PIXEL_MINIMAP_HEIGHT option if above 0, else width / 2

best_idea: A HUD column in which the event log fills whatever rows the fixed panels leave, and every panel returns the rows it did not use so they go back to the log.
decision_why: The fill-and-give-back column fits a phone HUD, but the donor has a dead redraw gate, a log that can sit off the screen when fixed panels overflow, a give-back that depends on draw order, and a recursion fallback. Frankendom keeps the two-pass column with the log always last, a clamp on the log, and a cut of the lowest panels first.
acceptance: On a 375 x 667 phone the column shows the health panel and the target panel, with the event log filling the rest; turning three panels off grows the log by their rows; a test asserts the column never exceeds the screen rows and that the log keeps at least 3 rows.
